excerpt.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
excerpt.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

label.en: We cannot do that right now.
We cannot do that right now.

texts.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
texts.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

sections.zh:
在我们历史的早期，在技术尚未有多少发展之时，我们的外星善主向我们告知了他们的存在。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。

曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途，他们改正了我们前进的方向——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的科学家掌握了电力、原子能，然后是初步太空航行。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们如今造出了我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]。
sections.en:
Early in our history, before we had developed much technology, our alien benefactors made themselves known to us. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.

On those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our scientists had mastered electricity, atomic power, and then crude spaceflight. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

sections.zh:
远在我们学会解读星辰之前，我们的外星善主便找到了我们——一个年轻而流浪的族群，勇气有余而知识不足，乘着方舟在黑暗中漂泊。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。

曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的工程师便学会了从方舟中获取到远比先祖所能想象的更多的能量。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们现在已经建造了第一台 [GetStartingDrive]。
sections.en:
Long before we had learned to read the stars, our alien benefactors found us - a young, wandering people with more courage than knowledge, drifting through the dark aboard our arkship. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.

On those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our engineers had learned to coax far more from our vessel than our ancestors had ever thought possible. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

texts.zh:
你们好，忠诚的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们做的很不错。在我们的引领下，你们已经掌握了超空间旅行的科技，第一次准备好要探索群星……正如我们曾经所做的一般，那是无数纪元以前了。

不要害怕——如果我们不觉得你们已经准备好了，我们是不会任已经发生的事件带领你们一路走到这里的。现在就出发，成为我们的骄傲吧。
texts.en:
Hello, faithful [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have done well for yourselves. With our guidance, you have mastered the technology of hyperspace travel and are now ready to set off into the stars for the first time... much as we once did, countless eons ago.

Have no fear - if we did not think you ready, we would not have allowed events to carry you as far as they have. Go now, and make us proud.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。实验的第一阶段成功完成——我们已经指引你们发展出了你们文明的第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]，现在你们已经准备好了探索群星。

放心吧，要知道第二阶段已经开始，我们会继续监督你们的进展。迄今为止，你们已经证明了自己格外机敏。和其他生物完全不同。

观察你们能用这一机会做到什么将会很有意思。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The first phase of the experiment has successfully concluded - we have guided you towards the development of your civilization's first [GetStartingDrivePlural], and you are now ready to take to the stars.

Rest assured in the knowledge that we will continue to monitor your progress now that the second phase has begun. Thus far, you have proven remarkably adroit. Not at all like the others.

It will be interesting to see what you make of this opportunity.

texts.zh:
从[from.GetName]的船员发回了一封紧急讯息，在[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中找到了[fromfrom.GetName]。

“[fromfrom.GetName]”……光是这个名字本身就已是传奇，有许多传说都是从摹照[overlord.GetName]流传下来的。[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们都知道这个地方是天堂，是无形的希望的灯塔。尽管我们肉眼可见其神圣性，但我们现在也面临着一个残酷的事实：这个神话般的圣地在现实中确实存在。

[overlord.GetName]还没有对我们的发现发表任何言论，但我们发现了他们非常密切地关注着这颗星球的证据。他们知道我们在这里，我们不知道如何解释他们对此一言不发。
texts.en:
Priority dispatch from the crew of [from.GetName], in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system: we have found [fromfrom.GetName].

"[fromfrom.GetName]"... Its very name is the stuff of legends, many of which were handed down in scripture from the [overlord.GetName]. Many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know this place to be paradise - a beacon of intangible hope - and though we can see that it is indeed divine, we are now also faced with a blunt fact: this mythical, holy place actually exists.

The [overlord.GetName] have yet to say anything about our discovery, but we found evidence that they watch this world very closely. They know we are here; we do not know how to interpret their silence.

label.zh: 我们的先辈显然信任着我们。
label.en: Our elders clearly have faith in us.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上可远远不止是有着丰富的资源和原始的生态系统。[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中的这颗[fromfrom.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一个古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。

这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技；因此我们相信这座信标属于附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。至于其作用：我们尚无法完全确定，但似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将这颗星球视作神圣。
texts.en:
There is more to [fromfrom.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [fromfrom.GetClassAdj] world in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system lies untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit.

The sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology; we therefore believe the marker belongs to the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName]. As to its purpose: we cannot say for sure, but it seems likely the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] consider this world to be holy.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上可远远不止是有着丰富的资源和原始的生态系统。[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中的这颗[fromfrom.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一个古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。

这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技，然而其设计却截然外物。因此我们只能假定这座信标属于现存或过去存在过的某个与他们相当的文明。按其外表所刻蚀的许多符号判断，它似乎用于标定一处圣地。
texts.en:
There is more to [fromfrom.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [fromfrom.GetClassAdj] world in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system lies untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit.

The sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology, however its design is distinctly alien. We must therefore assume the marker belongs to some contemporary of theirs, past or present. Judging by the various symbols etched onto its exterior: it may even be marking out a holy site.

texts.zh: 预兆判定你们应当因一直为我们服务接受这份礼物。不要浪费这份赠礼。
texts.en: The Augurs have decreed that you should receive this gift for your continued service to us. Do not squander it.

texts.zh: 仔细考虑过后，我们决定为实验引入另一个变量。请接受这份赠礼。随你们的意愿自行处理即可。
texts.en: After much deliberation, we have decided to introduce another variable to the experiment. Please accept this gift. Do with it as you will.

texts.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。一如既往，我们始终保持着对你们的观察，你们的一名领袖吸引了我们的注意。事实上，你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]，[desired_leader.GetName]的声名已经一路传到了我们的首都。

鉴于[desired_leader.GetHerHis]非比寻常的技能，我们想要为他在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上提供一个永久的职位。一份莫大的荣耀，可以这样讲。请尽快安排好对[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的调动。
texts.en:
Dearest [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As always, we have been observing you, and one of your leaders has attracted our attention. Indeed, the reputation of your [desired_leader.GetTitle], [desired_leader.GetName], has reached all the way to our capital.

Given [desired_leader.GetHerHis] unusual skills, we would like to offer a permanent position on [scion_master.Capital.GetName]. A great honor, to be sure. Please arrange for [desired_leader.GetHerHis] transfer as soon as possible.

label.zh: 不行，这位领袖得留在我们这。
label.en: No, this leader stays with us.

texts.zh:
你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有一名相当古怪的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]，宣称自己已经对在[scion_master.GetName]中的生活感到不耐烦——甚至可以说是厌倦！这个自以为是的家伙想要在星系里发展程度较低的文明中寻求一次挑战——按他的话来说是这样。

你会从我们这里接手[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？就算是我们欠了你们一份情。按照他的资历，我毫不怀疑他会在你们的领导职位上有良好的表现，但你们可能要容忍他那无常又冲动的举止。
texts.en:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There is a rather eccentric [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who claims to have grown restless - even bored! - of life as it is among the [scion_master.GetName]. This deluded individual seeks a challenge - their words - among the less developed civilizations of the galaxy.

Will you take this [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] off our hands, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You would be doing us a favor. Given their qualifications, I have no doubt they would serve you well in a leadership position, as long as you can tolerate their erratic and impulsive behavior.

label.zh: 我们没有空闲的岗位，抱歉。
label.en: We have no available positions, sorry.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们最近发现了一些没用的多余星舰。我们本打算把它们扔到最近的恒星里去，但突然想到了你们，我们亲爱的子弟。

这都是些老船了——一些甚至肯定比你们的整个文明都古老——但你们会发现它们还是颇具潜力的。收下吧，不客气。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we recently discovered several surplus starships that we have no use of. We were about to chuck them into the nearest sun, but then we thought of you, our dear scions.

These are old ships - some are no doubt older than your entire civilization - but you should find them quite potent. Please take them. We insist.

texts.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你们能不能努努力？你们的舰船也太落后了，这么磨磨蹭蹭可真令人生厌。

让你们的[root.GetScientistPlural]看看这些引擎的说明书吧。不客气。
texts.en:
Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... Would you care to pick up the pace a little? Your ships are lagging behind, and we grow tired of such dawdling.

Have your [root.GetScientistPlural] take a look at these engine specifications. We insist.

texts.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们觉得自己的努力还不错是吧？真好。

你们做得可真是……还行，不过我们希望你们还能百尺竿头更进一步。星系中还有那么多地盘可以吸收，而你们却如此故步自封！

别担心，因为我们已经帮你们准备好了补给包。谢就不用谢了，只要把它好好地用在新殖民地就行。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], hello! Do you feel your endeavors are going well? Splendid.

What you are doing is... fine, but we want to see you extend your reach a little further. There is so much more galaxy to take in, and yet you remain so cooped up!

Do not worry, though: we have prepared a supply package for you. No need to thank us; just be sure to invest it wisely in a new colony.

label.en: We cannot do that right now.

texts.zh:
嗟，动起来[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！不要轻易地接受失败。你就只需要挪到那儿，然后自己建个新家就好了。

快点，动啊。
texts.en:
Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Do not admit defeat so easily. You just need to get out there, and make a new home for yourselves.

Hurry along, now.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们的通讯装置看来是坏掉了。我们不断地收到你们不知感恩的丧气话。乖乖改正行不行?
texts.en: Your communications apparatus must be faulty, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: we keep receiving negative and ungrateful cross-chatter. See to that fault, won't you?

texts.zh:
我亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们该拿你怎么办哟？我们曾对你抱有如此高的期望，然而你却在这里，为了一场毫无意义的战争消磨你的潜力，而且你似乎正在输掉这场战争。[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有许多人认为我们应当与你们断交，但是那将算是承认了我们的错误，毕竟我们曾在你们这个特殊物种身上投入不少发展上的资金。

一支小的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]远征舰队已经置于你的指挥下。用它来结束战争——最好结局不是你灭绝。不要花太久。我们希望看到这只舰队的归来。并且，别让他们全灭！
texts.en:
Our dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... what are we to do with you? We had such high hopes, and yet here you are, squandering your potential in a pointless war that you seem to be losing. There are many on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who think we should cut all ties with you, but that would be an admission of error. We have invested quite a bit in the development of your peculiar species, after all.

A small [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] expeditionary fleet has been placed under your command. Use it to bring some sort of conclusion to the present hostilities - preferably one that doesn't include your extinction. Do not take too long. We will want this fleet back, eventually. And do not get them all killed!

label.zh: 谢谢……我们将会好好使用他们。
label.en: Thank you... we shall put them to good use.

texts.zh: [scion_master.GetName]借给我们的远征舰队已被摧毁。这或许会让他们不高兴……
texts.en: The Expeditionary Fleet lent to us by the [scion_master.GetName] has been utterly destroyed. This will likely upset them...

texts.zh:
我们的舰队在哪里，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们借给了你们舰队去结束那场愚蠢的战争。现在它在哪？不要装傻！

把我们的舰队还回来！
texts.en:
Where is our fleet, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The fleet we lent you to end your silly war. Where is it? No, do not feign ignorance!

GIVE US BACK OUR FLEET!

texts.zh: 奸诈的狗杂种。现在我们要索回我们的舰队。
texts.en: Treacherous cur. We will be taking our fleet back now.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们的线人告知我们你所参加的战争已经结束了。既然你还站在这，所以你们一定没有被彻底毁灭。

现在我们要带回我们的舰队。请未来尽量避免无法取得胜利的军事纠纷。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... our informants tell us the war you were in has ended. Since you are still here, it must not have been an utter disaster.

We will be taking our fleet back now. Do your best to keep out of unwinnable military entanglements in the future, please.
